title: Dragging a box on the timeline picks everything it touches, to move or delete together
goal: Dragging a box over the timeline picks every clip, piece, zoom, title, caption and key it touches, across tracks, so the person can then drag them all together in time or delete them in one go, the way Premiere and Final Cut marquee selection works. The person expected this and could not find it.
notes:
User's words: "I also expected marquee selection on the timeline, so that i could select multiple things and move or delete them."

From code reading (not run): a lane box exists. TimelineLaneMarquee.gesture on empty track space (TimelineTrackRows.swift:426, 446, 516; docs at :1010-1015): a click moves the playhead, a drag draws a box, Option or the Range tool picks a time range. EditorState+TrackRange.swift: LanePress/LaneBox (:27-43), endLanePress (:91-106) -> pickWithBox(within:onTracks:) which picks whole clips as picked layers or one piece as the piece in hand; drawn by TimelineLaneBoxView (TimelineDock.swift:1291-1330). Unknown why the user did not experience it: suspects are no empty space to start on in a full timeline, zoom/title/caption lanes not taking the gesture or not being picked, and the box not crossing into the Zoom lane. Companion: 'Pick several zooms at once and change or delete them together' (filed same day) owns the zoom multi-pick model this box feeds.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults with a real edit (several clips on several tracks, zooms, a title): try to box-select from empty space, from the gap between clips, from over a clip, and on the Zoom lane; record in the audit what each did and why the user could not find marquee selection (for example no empty space to start on, a press on a clip starts a move, zoom bars not included)

A drag that starts on empty track space or in a gap draws the box (as today) and picks clips, pieces, zoom bars, title and name card bars, caption cues and visible keys it touches; Shift adds to the current pick, Command toggles

There is a reliable way to start a box when the tracks are full of clips (for example starting on the empty area below the last track or on the ruler-free strip, or holding a modifier while pressing on a clip); the chosen way is checked against Premiere/Final Cut conventions and written in the audit

With a mixed pick, dragging any picked item moves all of them by the same time (keeping their tracks), snapping as a single drag does; Delete removes all of them in one undo step; Option-drag on empty space still picks a time range as today
The panel shows what is picked (a count and the kinds) and the settings they share
A walk at Next defaults boxes two clips, a zoom and a title, moves them half a second, undoes, deletes them, undoes, and photographs each step
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: from pick-several-zooms (2026-10-10): zooms can now be picked together (EditorState.pickedZooms), but dragging one bar of several picked carries only that bar (beginZoomDrag keeps the pick, ZoomDragSession holds one ref). Moving a picked group should move every picked zoom, as Premiere does; when this task adds group moves, zoom bars belong in it.

Reproduced at Next defaults (probe, real pointer windowDrag; recording on V1 with two zooms, a title at 0:01 on Title, Sample Music on Audio 2): (a) a drag from empty V1 space past the recording's end drew a box and picked Sample Music: the box works where there is empty space. (b) a drag starting in the gap between the two zoom bars on the Zoom lane picked NOTHING (the lane's press only lets go of a zoom). (c) a drag starting on the strip below the last track (the Add Track row) picked NOTHING: that strip has no box gesture. (d) a drag starting over the recording MOVED the recording to 3.9s, as Premiere and Final Cut do. Why the user could not find it: in a normal recording edit the recording and its sound run the whole timeline end to end, so the only empty space is the Zoom lane and the strip under the tracks, and neither starts a box; and a box never picks zoom bars or keys even where it does start.

Before building (adversarial): a first-time user with a recording that fills the timeline has no empty space to start a box, so the fix is a place that is always empty (the strip under the last track, as Final Cut's area under the storyline and Premiere's empty tracks) plus the Zoom lane's gaps; pressing on a clip keeps moving the clip, as in both editors, so no modifier-on-a-clip invention. A zoom or key lives on its clip's clock, so one on a picked clip rides with it; only those on unpicked clips move on their own. Found in review: a zoom with no room was silently left behind while the rest moved, so the group now stops where the tightest zoom or key runs out of room (boxExtrasRoom, tested).

Built: PhotonzCore/TimelineBoxPick.swift (marqueeZooms, marqueeKeys, shiftBoxExtras, removeBoxExtras, boxExtrasRoom, TimelinePickSummary; 13 tests in TimelineBoxPickTests). App: EditorState+TrackRange (box picks zooms/keys via zoomLaneRows/keyLaneRows, Shift adds/Command toggles, boxExtras kept with the clip pick they were made beside, deleteBoxPick, beginBoxPickDrag), clip bar drag carries extras (EditorState+ClipBar), zoom bar/key drag in a box pick carries the whole pick through the clip bar drag, several picked zooms move together (ZoomDragSession.group), box starts on Zoom lane gaps (ZoomLane), on the Add Track strip and the space under it (TimelineTrackRows, TimelineDock), panel Properties shows 'N picked' + kinds first (PropertyKeysInspector, InspectorPanel). Harness: dragTracks takes 'Zoom <clip>', 'Under the tracks' and modifiers; expectTimelinePick reads zooms and keys; expectClip takes '<clip> zoom <n>'.

left rough (none clears the follow-up bar on its own; all in the audit's rough list): a pick with zooms/keys from unpicked clips cannot change track; Option-drag copy of a box pick copies clips only; Shift-Delete on whole clips leaves the extras; key lanes keep their own one-layer box; the under-tracks strip is 20pt and unlabeled.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh hung at 0% CPU after walks (the open hang task, logged there); split run passed 11073 + 1153 + 76. Walks green: box-picks-everything-it-touches-walk (harness, 90 steps), box-pick-by-hand-walk (real pointer windowDrag box and zoom bar drag), and neighbours a-gap-* (3), a-shape-s-bar-keeps-its-track, a-zoom-follows-the-cursor, closing-a-gap-carries-the-title-and-music, empty-track-slot, keys-copy-between-layers, marquee-and-track-range, pick-several-zooms, several-clips-show-where-each-lands, tracks-you-can-add-rename-group, pick-a-track-and-delete-it, a-click-on-the-zoom-bar-frames-it, a-zoom-is-shaped-by-hand, border-width-keys.

Shipped in 5b8204c2 (Next, no flag): a box starts on empty track space, between zoom bars, and on the strip under the last track (reproduced first: before, only empty track space started one, and a recording edit has none). It picks clips, pieces, titles, sounds, zoom bars and keys it touches; Shift adds, Command flips. Dragging any picked clip, zoom bar or key carries the whole pick by the same time on its own tracks, snapping as a clip does and stopping where a zoom or key runs out of room; Delete takes all of it in one undo; Option-drag still picks a range. Panel leads with 'N picked' and the kinds above the shared sections. Core TimelineBoxPick.swift + 13 tests; split test run green (11073+1153+76; full run hit the known hang). Walks box-picks-everything-it-touches-walk and box-pick-by-hand-walk (real pointer) green, plus 18 neighbouring walks. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-10-timeline-box-picks-everything.json.
